meta.name: add-slack
meta.description: Add Slack channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.tagline: 把 Slack 频道接入你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你开发的应用需要 Slack 聊天功能
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Slack channels into your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need Slack chat in your app

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 可代你把服务接入 Slack:复制并注册适配器、安装依赖,然后引导你创建 Slack 应用、选 Socket Mode 或 webhook 并填令牌,最后构建、测试并重启。
howto.when: 当你说要接入 Slack(如“添加 Slack 频道”或“给 NanoClaw 接 Slack”)时,Claude 会开始执行本技能。

say.text: 用 add-slack 技能把项目接入 Slack。
say.note: 会复制注册适配器、装依赖,并询问事件投递方式。

say.text: 给 NanoClaw 接入 Slack,用 Socket Mode。
say.note: 走 Socket Mode,无需公网地址;配置令牌后重启。

say.text: 我要用 webhook 方式接 Slack。
say.note: 需公网 HTTPS 地址,会指导配置事件投递。

howto.what_en: With this skill Claude can wire Slack into your project: it copies and registers the Slack adapter, installs a pinned dependency, guides you through creating a Slack app and choosing Socket Mode or webhook, then builds, tests, and restarts the service.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to connect your project to Slack, e.g., “add a Slack channel” or “hook NanoClaw up to Slack.” Claude then runs through the skill steps.

say_en.text: Use the add-slack skill to connect my project to Slack.
Set up Slack for NanoClaw with Socket Mode.
say_en.note: No public URL needed; it configures tokens and restarts the service.

say_en.text: I want to connect Slack via webhook.
say_en.note: Requires a public HTTPS endpoint; Claude guides the event delivery setup.
